definitions.explanation: the activity of observing wild birds in their natural habitat, often as a hobby

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鳥見|とりみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{早朝|そうちょう}→早朝：03109_souchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鳥見|とりみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
{鳥見|とりみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{双眼鏡|そうがんきょう}→双眼鏡：11981_sougankyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{野鳥図鑑|やちょうずかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: Since I started birdwatching, I've bought binoculars and a field guide to wild birds.

notes:
USAGE:
{鳥見|とりみ} is the native Japanese term for birdwatching. The English loanword ⟦バードウォッチング→バードウォッチング：08814_baadowocchingu⟧ is also commonly used. {鳥見|とりみ} has a slightly more casual, colloquial feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鳥見|とりみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go birdwatching)
- {鳥見|とりみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める (to start birdwatching)
- {鳥見|とりみ}⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧ (birdwatching spot)

RELATED WORDS:
- {野鳥観察|やちょうかんさつ} (wild bird observation - more formal)
- {探鳥会|たんちょうかい} (birdwatching group/event)
